Class ResourceCategory

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.resource.ResourceCategory
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
public final class ResourceCategory extends Object implements net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
A family of resources, e.g. energyplugin:energy or mymod:fluid (ARCHITECTURE.md §9.1). MachineEngine attaches no meaning to categories.

Amounts are longs in base units (D10). scale() is the number of decimal digits used when displaying them: a scale of 3 shows 1500 base units as 1.500.

Definitions are canonical: compare them by reference.
